simplify_sympy_expression: simplify a SymPy mathematical expression with a configurable timeout to avoid long-running computations
convert_tree_to_torch_module: convert a symbolic regression tree into a PyTorch module for fast tensor-based evaluation
convert_tree_to_numpy_fn: convert a symbolic regression tree into a NumPy function for batch evaluation on arrays
convert_sympy_to_prefix: convert a SymPy expression into a prefix notation list using the SYMPY_OPERATORS mapping
apply_simplification_functions: apply a stack of simplification functions like expand or simplify to a symbolic regression tree
